# ============================================================================
# third_party/bearssl/CMakeLists.txt — BearSSL, two independent builds.
#
# (1) HOST build — full library + the brssl tool.
#     brssl generates PREBUILT trust-anchor C arrays (`brssl ta`) so the OS
#     port needs no runtime PEM parsing. Output: build/host-tls/brssl.
#
# (2) OS build — a minimal TLS 1.2 client subset linked into browser.elf.
#     Deliberately excluded (unchanged from the old Makefile): server-side
#     code, keygen, PEM/encoder, CBC, CCM, 3DES, ChaCha, TLS 1.0/1.1.
#
# The host build must NEVER be linked into a target ELF, and the OS build must
# never be compiled with host flags. They are separate targets with separate
# flag sets, and the OS objects are consumed only by apps/browser.
# ============================================================================

set(_bl_dir "${KYUZEN_ROOT}/third_party/bearssl")

# ===========================================================================
# (1) HOST: full library + brssl tool.
# ===========================================================================
file(GLOB _bl_host_subdirs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_bl_dir}/src/*/*.c")
file(GLOB _bl_host_tools   CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_bl_dir}/tools/*.c")

add_library(kyuzen-bearssl-host STATIC
    ${_bl_host_subdirs}
    "${_bl_dir}/src/settings.c"
)
target_include_directories(kyuzen-bearssl-host PUBLIC
    ${_bl_dir}/inc
    ${_bl_dir}/src
)
# Host code: no freestanding flags, no target triple.
target_compile_options(kyuzen-bearssl-host PRIVATE -O1 -w)
set_target_properties(kyuzen-bearssl-host PROPERTIES
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/host-tls"
)

add_executable(kyuzen-brssl ${_bl_host_tools})
target_link_libraries(kyuzen-brssl PRIVATE kyuzen-bearssl-host)
target_include_directories(kyuzen-brssl PRIVATE "${_bl_dir}/tools")
target_compile_options(kyuzen-brssl PRIVATE -O1 -w)
set_target_properties(kyuzen-brssl PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/host-tls"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Trust anchors generated by brssl from the test CA / root store.
#
# These are GENERATED SOURCE files that the browser links. The old Makefile
# wrote them into the source tree (apps/browser/tls/tas_*.inc) because the
# browser's own #include references them by that path. They are gitignored.
#
# A custom target (not a build-byproduct) so the generated files exist before
# apps/browser compiles — the old Makefile achieved the same ordering by
# making the .inc file a prerequisite of every BL_OS_OBJS object.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(_bl_tas_testca "${KYUZEN_ROOT}/apps/browser/tls/tas_testca.inc")
set(_bl_tas_https  "${KYUZEN_ROOT}/apps/browser/tls/tas_https.inc")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${_bl_tas_testca}"
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:kyuzen-brssl> ta
            "${KYUZEN_ROOT}/tests/browser_site/certs/testca.crt"
            > "${_bl_tas_testca}"
    DEPENDS kyuzen-brssl
            "${KYUZEN_ROOT}/tests/browser_site/certs/testca.crt"
    COMMENT "brssl: generating trust anchors (test CA)"
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${_bl_tas_https}"
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:kyuzen-brssl> ta
            "${KYUZEN_ROOT}/tests/browser_site/certs/roots_https.pem"
            > "${_bl_tas_https}"
    DEPENDS kyuzen-brssl
            "${KYUZEN_ROOT}/tests/browser_site/certs/roots_https.pem"
    COMMENT "brssl: generating trust anchors (HTTPS roots)"
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(kyuzen-bearssl-tas DEPENDS
    "${_bl_tas_testca}"
    "${_bl_tas_https}"
)

# ===========================================================================
# (2) OS: minimal TLS client subset for browser.elf.
#
# Compiled with kyuzen-flags-bearssl-os (freestanding, SSE off, all built-in
# entropy/time sources disabled — the port supplies them via syscalls).
# ===========================================================================
set(_bl_os_sources
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_client.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_engine.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_hs_client.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_hashes.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/prf.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/prf_sha256.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_rec_gcm.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_engine_default_aesgcm.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_engine_default_ec.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_engine_default_ecdsa.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ssl/ssl_engine_default_rsavrfy.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/x509/x509_minimal.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/x509/x509_decoder.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/sha2small.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/sha2big.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/sha1.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/multihash.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/dig_size.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/dig_oid.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/mac/hmac.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rand/hmac_drbg.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rand/sysrng.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/symcipher/aes_common.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/symcipher/aes_ct.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/symcipher/aes_ct64.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/symcipher/aes_ct_ctr.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/symcipher/aes_ct64_ctr.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/symcipher/aes_ct_enc.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/symcipher/aes_ct64_enc.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/ghash_ctmul.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/ghash_ctmul32.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/hash/ghash_ctmul64.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_default.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_all_m31.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_prime_i31.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_p256_m31.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_secp256r1.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_secp384r1.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_secp521r1.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_c25519_m31.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ec_pubkey.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ecdsa_atr.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ecdsa_default_vrfy_asn1.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ecdsa_default_vrfy_raw.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ecdsa_i31_bits.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ecdsa_i31_vrfy_asn1.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/ec/ecdsa_i31_vrfy_raw.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rsa/rsa_default_pkcs1_vrfy.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rsa/rsa_i31_pkcs1_vrfy.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rsa/rsa_i62_pkcs1_vrfy.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rsa/rsa_i62_pub.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rsa/rsa_pkcs1_sig_unpad.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/rsa/rsa_i31_pub.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/int/i62_modpow2.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/int/i32_div32.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/codec/ccopy.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/codec/enc32be.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/codec/enc32le.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/codec/dec32be.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/codec/dec32le.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/codec/enc64be.c
    ${_bl_dir}/src/codec/dec64be.c
    # --- Kyuzen port: syscall-backed entropy + time -------------------------
    ${KYUZEN_ROOT}/apps/browser/tls/tls_kyuzen.c
)

# int/i31_*.c is a wildcard in the old Makefile (many small integer helpers).
file(GLOB _bl_i31 CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_bl_dir}/src/int/i31_*.c")
list(APPEND _bl_os_sources ${_bl_i31})

add_library(kyuzen-bearssl-os OBJECT ${_bl_os_sources})
target_link_libraries(kyuzen-bearssl-os PRIVATE kyuzen-flags-bearssl-os)

# The generated trust-anchor headers are #included by tls_kyuzen.c, so every
# OS object depends on them (this is the ordering the old Makefile expressed
# with an explicit prerequisite on the pattern rule).
add_dependencies(kyuzen-bearssl-os kyuzen-bearssl-tas)

# Upstream code we do not modify.
target_compile_options(kyuzen-bearssl-os PRIVATE -w)
